image_description: A product shot of a white Logitech speaker system against a plain white background. The set includes a large, boxy subwoofer on the left with a prominent circular black grille, and two smaller satellite speakers to the right. The front satellite speaker shows two distinct driver units (a larger mid-range/woofer and a smaller tweeter) vertically aligned. The rear satellite speaker is partially visible behind the front one.
